question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in Germany, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur's Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) is the official unit-level register of reported grid-connected battery units in Germany: status, gross/net kW, usable kWh, PLZ/Gemeinde (coordinates only above 30 kW), operator and commissioning date. Query it without login through the public viewer's JSON service or the daily XML export. On 2026-11-26, 2,929,627 battery units were In Betrieb, 556 of them above 1 MW (4.75 GW, 8.37 GWh). Rows are units: group sites by LokationMastrNr. Natural-person operators are masked.
main_caveats: MaStR rows are units (SEE), not installations: one site can be many units (SWM Uppenborn: 10 × 2,610 kW). Group by LokationMastrNr (SEL) and sum storage rows only.
Over 99.8% of the 2.93 million operating battery units are connected at Niederspannung; there is no official grid-scale flag, so state the size or voltage filter used.
Coordinates are withheld for units ≤30 kW and for a few large anonymised units (e.g. RWE Werne, LEAG Big Battery Lausitz), which show only PLZ and place.
Natural-person operators are masked; data are self-declared and registered up to a month (sometimes more) after commissioning, so the latest weeks are incomplete.
The viewer's CSV export stops at 25,000 rows; use the JSON paging or the daily XML export.
answer.confidence_reason: All counts and field meanings come from live MaStR queries, the official export documentation and the MaStRV text opened on 2026-11-26; only the non-official sources stayed untested.

attributes.note: Every unit has PLZ/Ort/Gemeinde; WGS84 coordinates only for units >30 kW (§15 MaStRV): 6,646 operating units, 550 of 556 >1 MW.
Bruttoleistung and Nettonennleistung in kW, discharge (Ausspeicher) side; no charging-power field for batteries. Kraftwerksliste in MW.
NutzbareSpeicherkapazitaet in kWh on the linked storage object (SSE); empty for 57 operating units, filled for all 556 >1 MW.
Operator name and ABR number for organisations; 'natürliche Person (ABR…)' for 2,851,374 operating units, incl. 19 of 556 >1 MW.
attributes.gap_note: §15 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 MaStRV: data of natural-person operators are not published; only the masked ABR number is visible.

attributes.note: Inbetriebnahmedatum (first technical commissioning) for all operating units; registration date and date at current site are separate fields.

problems: The page's CSV table export is capped: 'Der Tabellen-Export enthält nur die ersten 25.000 Datensätze Ihrer Auswahl.'
Operator identity withheld for natural persons; location reduced to PLZ/Ort for units ≤30 kW and for some large units flagged as anonymised.
The JSON service is the viewer's internal grid endpoint; it is not documented as an API (the documented interfaces are the XML download and a registered SOAP Webdienst).

local_terms.meaning: Federal register of all generation and storage units, run by the Bundesnetzagentur; the official source for this question.
Electricity storage / battery storage; MaStR Energieträger 'Speicher', Speichertechnologie 'Batterie'.
Grid-scale battery; BNetzA usage: Bruttoleistung greater than 999 kW.
Usable storage capacity in kWh (MaStR field on the storage object SSE).
Commissioning date of the unit (first technical commissioning).
Operating status filter value meaning 'in operation' (others: In Planung, vorübergehend / endgültig stillgelegt).
Technical location grouping all units behind common grid connection points; use it to build sites.
Operator of the unit; masked when a natural person.
